sourceScript.title: The Adventure Begins
sourceScript.activatedBy: Julian explicit no-pollen-bags direction, applied by Codex

directorStatement.audienceFeeling: Calmed, attentive, and gently drawn toward Keen’s coming departure.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Aida moves from still listening to a quiet, chosen action.
directorStatement.theLaugh: No comedy beat; the scene plays as soft anticipation.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: The pendant glow opens into a pier vision without becoming flashy.
directorStatement.carryForward: Aida heads toward the forest to reach Keen before the journey.

shots.purpose: Reset the pace through Aida’s quiet listening ritual.
shots.performanceAssignment: Aida sits beside the bowl with the wand just off the rim, then eases it into a slow circle. Her breathing settles, her eyelids close, and the pendant glow gradually lifts light across her face.
shots.camera: Slow push-in from wide shore to calm medium.
shots.openingPose: Aida seated frame-center beside the bowl, wand hovering near the rim, eyes open.
shots.visualPayoff: Aida’s closed-eyed stillness fills the quieted cove.

continuityOut.lighting: soft shore daylight with subtle pendant glow on Aida
continuityOut.cameraSide: ocean remains screen-left, forest remains screen-right

characters.pose: seated beside crystal bowl, wand circling rim

shots.purpose: Show Keen’s departure as Aida senses it.
shots.performanceAssignment: The vision opens on the pier and waiting boat. Keen stands by his supplies, lifts the satchel strap, checks it, releases it, then repeats the check twice more while glancing toward the nearby adult presence.
shots.camera: Vision POV, steady medium-wide with slight drift toward Keen.
shots.openingPose: Keen stands near the pier supplies, one hand just reaching for his satchel strap.
shots.cutInMotivation: The pendant glow and bowl tone dissolve into Aida’s inner vision.
shots.visualPayoff: Keen finishes a third careful strap check beside the boat.

shots.purpose: Aida accepts what she sensed and leaves to help.
shots.performanceAssignment: Back on shore, the glow fades from Aida’s eyes. She lowers the wand beside the bowl, places one hand over her heart, smiles softly, speaks her single line, then rises and walks toward the forest.
shots.camera: Medium close, then gentle pan right following her exit.
shots.openingPose: Aida seated beside the bowl, eyes closed, wand near rim, pendant glow beginning to fade.
shots.cutInMotivation: The bowl tone bridges the vision release back to Aida on the shore.
shots.dialogueBinding: Aida’s line lands after the heart touch, before she rises.
